```{r project organization, message=F, echo=T, eval=T, warning=F, include=T, cache=T}
# project name
proj = "HNGU_proj1"

# create directories
if(!dir.exists("figures")){dir.create("figures")}
if(!dir.exists("output_data")){dir.create("output_data")} 
if(!dir.exists("scripts")){dir.create("scripts")} 
#if(!dir.exists("scripts/QIIME2")){dir.create("scripts/QIIME2")} 

### create color vector for later use
library(RColorBrewer)

# define a color vector using brewer.pal and colorset
colvec = c(brewer.pal(8,"Dark2"),brewer.pal(8,"Set2"),brewer.pal(8,"Accent"),brewer.pal(8,"Paired"),brewer.pal(12,"Set3"),brewer.pal(9,"Set1"))

colorset <- c(
  paletteer::paletteer_d("LaCroixColoR::Orange"),
  paletteer::paletteer_d("yarrr::usualsuspects"),

)
```

```{r import data}

asv_tab = read_tsv("input_data/Total relative abundance clean_pvee.txt")
tax_tab = read.xlsx("input_data/tax_table.xlsx") %>% as_tibble()
sam_dat = read.xlsx("input_data/sample_data.xlsx", detectDates = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()
env_data_raw = read.xlsx("input_data/BioP-fixed.xlsx", sheet = 2, detectDates = TRUE) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::dmy(date))
interpolated_Fe = read.xlsx("input_data/interpolated_data.xlsx", detectDates = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()

# environmental factors
env_data_filt = 
  env_data_raw %>% 
  filter(date %in% sam_dat$date) %>% 
  arrange(date) %>% 
  inner_join(., sam_dat, by = "date", multiple = "first") %>% 
  select(sampleID, everything()) 

# add env data for sample 27
env_data_filt_s27 = 
  env_data_filt %>% filter(sampleID == "sample26") %>% 
  mutate(sampleID = "sample27")

env_data2 = 
  bind_rows(env_data_filt, env_data_filt_s27)

# import additional tank temperature data
tank_temp = 
  openxlsx::read.xlsx("input_data/new tank temperature.xlsx", detectDates = T) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    janitor::clean_names() %>% 
    rename(date_tank_temperature_data = "date",
           temperature_in_niitrification_tank_1 = "temp_tank")

# add temp_tank to env_data
env_data = 
inner_join(env_data2[-4], interpolated_Fe, by = c("date" = "Date")) %>% 
  left_join(., tank_temp, by = "date") %>% 
  select(sampleID, date, temp_tank, `Total.Fe.(g/kg.TS).Secondary.sludge.V08`, everything())

# check correlation temp_tank and tavg
env_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = tavg, y = temp_tank)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F)

# physeq otu_table
ps_otus = otu_table(data.frame(asv_tab)[,-1], taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
sample_names(ps_otus) = colnames(asv_tab)[-1]
taxa_names(ps_otus) = data.frame(asv_tab)[,1]

# physeq tax_table
ps_tax = tax_table(as.matrix(tax_tab[,-1]))
taxa_names(ps_tax) = data.frame(asv_tab)[,1]

# physeq sam_dat
ps_samdat = sample_data(data.frame(sam_dat))
sample_names(ps_samdat) = ps_samdat$sampleID

# compile physeq
physeq = phyloseq(ps_otus, ps_tax, ps_samdat)


## import physeq from qiime2
physeq2 = 
qiime2R::qza_to_phyloseq(features = "input_data/QIIME2_output/featureTable.qza",
                         taxonomy = "input_data/QIIME2_output/seq_taxonomy.qza",
                         tree = "input_data/QIIME2_output/rooted-tree.qza"
                         #metadata = "input_data/sample_data.xlsx"
                          ) 

# add metadata and match sample names from otu_table
sam_dat_physeq2 = 
physeq2 %>% 
  otu_table(.) %>% colnames() %>% as_tibble() %>% filter(grepl("HA.", value)) %>% 
  mutate(date = str_remove(string = value, pattern = "HA."),
         date = lubridate::dmy(date, quiet = T)) %>% 
  inner_join(., sam_dat, by = "date") %>% 
  sample_data() 


# adjust duplicated sample name at last sampling date
sam_dat_physeq2$value[27] = paste0(sam_dat_physeq2$value[27],"2")
sample_names(sam_dat_physeq2) = sam_dat_physeq2$value

# add metadata to physeq2
physeq2 = phyloseq(otu_table(physeq2), tax_table(physeq2), sam_dat_physeq2)
sample_names(physeq2) = sam_dat_physeq2$sampleID

```

```{r genus level tax glom}
# genus core
```

```{r plot_bar all genera, echo=T, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}

#ps_Genus_rare_rel

# count n genera n = 217
psmelt_genus_core %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(Genus = factor(Genus)) %>% 
  pull(Genus) %>% 
  levels() %>% 
  length()

# Define a function to find the first non-matching column

# Use rowwise and mutate to apply the function
ps_Genus_taxlabel = psmelt_genus_core %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),  ~str_replace_all(., ",", "."))) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(~ all(grepl("^-?\\d*\\.?\\d*$", .))), as.numeric)) %>% 
  select(Sample, Abundance, date:Genus) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(tax_label = case_when(
    grepl("\\d", Genus) ~ {
      first_non_numeric <- case_when(
        !grepl("\\d", Family) ~ paste(Family, Genus, sep = " "),
        !grepl("\\d", Order) ~ paste(Order, Genus, sep = " "),
        !grepl("\\d", Class) ~ paste(Class, Genus, sep = " "),
        !grepl("\\d", Phylum) ~ paste(Phylum, Genus, sep = " "),
        !grepl("\\d", Kingdom) ~ paste(Kingdom, Genus, sep = " "),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
      first_non_numeric
    },
    TRUE ~ Genus
  ))

Genus_abundances <- 
  ps_Genus_taxlabel %>% 
  #mutate(Sample_nr = str_sub(Sample, start = 1, end = 2)) %>% 
  group_by_at(vars(Sample, date, tax_label)) %>% 
  summarise(rel_abund = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>% 
  mutate(mean_rel_abund = rel_abund/sum(rel_abund)*100) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(Sample, date, tax_label) %>% 
  mutate(tax_label = str_replace(tax_label, "(.*)_unclassified", "Unclassified *\\1*"),
         tax_label = str_replace(tax_label, "^(\\S*)$", "*\\1*"))

# Reduce genera to lower number (at least 3%, or else called other)
Genus_pool <- Genus_abundances %>% 
  group_by(tax_label) %>% 
  summarise(pool = max(mean_rel_abund) < 1, 
            mean = mean(mean_rel_abund), 
            .groups = "drop")

# name the taxon colors
inner_join(Genus_abundances, Genus_pool, by="tax_label") %>% 
  mutate(tax_label = if_else(pool, "Other max.<3%", tax_label)) %>% 
  group_by(tax_label) %>%
  summarise(mean_rel_abund = sum(mean_rel_abund), 
            median = median(mean),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(tax_label = factor(tax_label), 
         tax_label = fct_reorder(tax_label, median, .desc = T)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(median)) %>% pull(tax_label) %>% unique() -> names(colorset)

colorset["Other max.<1%"] <- "#D3D3D3"

# reshape plot data
plot_data <-
inner_join(Genus_abundances, Genus_pool, by="tax_label") %>% 
  mutate(tax_label = if_else(pool, "Other max.<1%", tax_label)) %>% 
  # mutate(Sample = if_else(grepl(".*[^0-9][0-9]{2}$", Sample),
  #                          Sample,
  #                          str_c(str_sub(Sample, end = -2),"0", str_sub(Sample, -1)))) %>% 
  group_by(Sample, date, tax_label) %>%
  summarise(mean_rel_abund = sum(mean_rel_abund), 
            mean = min(mean),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(Sample  = factor(Sample, levels = c(paste0("sample", seq(1:length(unique(psmelt_genus_core$Sample))))))) %>% 
  mutate(tax_label = factor(tax_label), 
         tax_label = fct_reorder(tax_label, mean, .desc = T)
         )

plot_data %>% 
  write_csv(glue::glue("output_data/{proj}_relative_genus_abundances_prev50_1pct.csv", col_names = T, append = F))


# plot the data per sample
# plot function
create_barplot <- 
  function(data, colorset, date) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Sample, y = mean_rel_abund, fill = tax_label)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Genus", values = colorset) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
    #scale_x_discrete(labels = PMA_label) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Abundance (%)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_markdown(),
          legend.key.size = unit(7, "pt"),
          legend.position = "right",
          strip.background = element_rect(colour = "white"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 14)) #+
    # facet_nested(cols = vars(dna_type, sample_type, exp_id), 
    #              labeller = labeller(dna_type = dna_type_label, sample_type = sample_type_label),
    #              scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
    #              nest_line = element_line(lineend = "round"), 
    #              resect = unit(2, "mm"))
  }

# Apply the plotting function to each nested data frame
plots <- 
  create_barplot(plot_data, colorset, date) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(plot_data$date, plot_data$Sample)) +  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(plots)

ggsave(plot = plots, filename = glue("figures/{proj}_plot_barplot_genus_core50prev_0.01abund.pdf"), width = 13, height =8)

```

```{r beta diversity, echo=F}
physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus

# samples that also have the required metadata (V08):
# sample_subset = 
#   env_data %>% 
#   mutate(across(is.numeric, ~scale(.x, center = T, scale = T))) %>% 
#   select(sampleID, date, tavg, total_fe_g_kg_ts_secondary_sludge_v08) %>% 
#   filter(!is.na(total_fe_g_kg_ts_secondary_sludge_v08)) %>% 
#   pull(sampleID)

# subset samples
# physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus_noNA_metadata = 
# physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus %>% 
#   subset_samples(sampleID %in% sample_subset) %>% 
#   prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.)>0,.)

# ordination
PCoA_BC <- ordinate(physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

# Extract eigenvalues
eigenvalues <- PCoA_BC$values$Relative_eig

# percent explained labeling
pretty_pe <- format(round(eigenvalues[1:2]*100, digits = 1), nsmall =1, trim=T)

# axis labels 
labs <- c(glue("PCoA 1 ({pretty_pe[1]}%)"),
          glue("PCoA 2 ({pretty_pe[2]}%)"))

plot_data_biplot = 
  plot_ordination(physeq = physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus, 
                  ordination = PCoA_BC, 
                  type = "biplot", 
                  axes = c(1,2),
                  justDF = T
                  ) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames="Sample") %>%
  mutate(functional_group = 
           case_when(
             grepl("Accumulibacter|Tetrasphaera|Dechloromonas",Genus) ~ "PAO",
             grepl("Leptothrix|Sphaerotilus|Aquabacterium|Acidovorax|Ferritrophicum|Rhodobacter",Genus) ~ "IOB",
             grepl("Competibacter|Contendobacter|Defluviicoccus",Genus) ~ "GAO",
             grepl("Rhodoferax|Aeromonas|Geothrix|Pseudomonas|^Bacillus|Mucispirillum|Acidiphilium|Anaeromyxobacter|Serratia",Genus) ~ "DIRB",
             grepl("Thiobacillus",Genus) ~ "IOB/DIRB",
             TRUE ~ "other"))


# plot PCoA ordination
plot_PCoA_BC <- 
plot_data_biplot %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Axis.1, y=Axis.2)) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data_biplot %>% filter(id.type == "Samples"),
             aes(fill = date), size=3, shape = 21, color = "black", show.legend = T) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data_biplot %>% filter(id.type == "Taxa"), 
             aes(color = functional_group, shape = functional_group),size=2, show.legend = T) +
  #ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = PMA), size = 2, min.segment.length = 1) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(6, "Dark2")) +
  #scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = labs[1], y = labs[2]) +
  #scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkred", high = "darkblue") +
  ggtitle(glue::glue("PCoA ordination Genus-level Bray-Curtis dissimilarity")) +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 90),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
  panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth = 0.3),
  axis.line.x = element_line(color="black", size = 0.3),
  axis.line.y = element_line(color="black", size = 0.3)) 

# save PCoA beta diversity
plot_PCoA_BC 

filtered_data <- plot_data_biplot %>% 
  filter(id.type == "Samples" | (id.type == "Taxa" & functional_group != "other"))

plot_PCoA_BC <- 
  filtered_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data_biplot %>% filter(id.type == "Samples"),
             aes(fill = date), size=3, shape = 21, color = "black", show.legend = T) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data_biplot %>% filter((id.type == "Taxa" & functional_group != "other")), 
             aes(color = functional_group, shape = functional_group),size=2, show.legend = T) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = labs[1], y = labs[2]) +
  #scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkred", high = "darkblue") +
  scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(6, "Dark2")) +
  ggtitle(glue::glue("PCoA ordination Genus-level Bray-Curtis dissimilarity")) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 90),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color="black", size = 0.3),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color="black", size = 0.3)) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Genus, color = functional_group), size = 2)

print(plot_PCoA_BC)

ggsave(plot = plot_PCoA_BC, filename = glue("figures/{proj}_plot_beta_diversity_genus_BC.pdf"), width = 8, height =5)
```

```{r env_fit to PCoA}

# Compute the environmental fit
env_data_scaled = 
  env_data %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~scale(.x, center = T, scale = T))) %>% 
  select(sample_id, date, temp_tank, total_fe_g_kg_ts_secondary_sludge_v08) %>% 
  #filter(!is.na(total_fe_g_kg_ts_secondary_sludge_v08))
  select(where(~ !any(is.na(.)))) # remove variables/columns containing NAs
  
envfit_results <- envfit(PCoA_BC$vectors, env_data_scaled[, 3:ncol(env_data_scaled)], permutations = 999)


# plot BC with discrete colours for date
plot_PCoA_BC_discrete = 
  filtered_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data_biplot %>% filter(id.type == "Samples"),
             aes(fill = date), size=3, shape = 21, color = "black", show.legend = T) +
  geom_point(data = plot_data_biplot %>% filter((id.type == "Taxa" & functional_group != "other")), 
             aes(color = functional_group, shape = functional_group),size=2, show.legend = T) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = labs[1], y = labs[2]) +
  #scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkred", high = "darkblue") +
  #scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(6, "Dark2")) +
  ggtitle(glue::glue("PCoA ordination Genus-level Bray-Curtis dissimilarity")) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 90),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color="black", size = 0.3),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color="black", size = 0.3)) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = as.character(date)), color = "black", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = Genus, color = functional_group), size = 2)


# plot + env fit results (vectors scaled x0.3)
plot_PCoA_BC_envfit = 
plot_PCoA_BC_discrete +
  geom_segment(data = as.data.frame(scores(envfit_results, display = "vectors")),
               aes(x = 0, xend = Axis.1 *0.3, y = 0, yend = Axis.2*0.3),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")), color = "darkred") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = as.data.frame(scores(envfit_results, display = "vectors")),
            aes(x = Axis.1*0.3, y = Axis.2*0.3, label = rownames(as.data.frame(scores(envfit_results, display = "vectors")))), color = "darkred", hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) 

print(plot_PCoA_BC_envfit)

# save PCoA + env fit
ggsave(plot = plot_PCoA_BC_envfit, filename = glue("figures/{proj}_plot_PCoA_genus_BC_envfit_Fe.pdf"), width = 8, height =5)
```

```{r capscale plot prev50 abun0.01, eval=T, echo=T}
cap_scores <- scores(cap, display = c("sites", "species", "bp"), scaling = 1)

  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(env_data_scaled, by = "sample_id")  # join metadata

# Species (taxa) scores
# 1. Extract species scores from capscale
species_df <- as.data.frame(scores(cap, display = "species", scaling = 1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV") %>% 
  inner_join(., 
             tax_table(physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus) %>% data.frame() %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ASV"),
             by = "ASV")

# 2. Add functional_group based on your rules
species_df <- species_df %>%
  mutate(functional_group = case_when(
    grepl("Accumulibacter|Tetrasphaera|Dechloromonas", Genus) ~ "PAO",
    grepl("Leptothrix|Sphaerotilus|Aquabacterium|Acidovorax|Ferritrophicum|Rhodobacter", Genus) ~ "IOB",
    grepl("Competibacter|Contendobacter|Defluviicoccus", Genus) ~ "GAO",
    grepl("Rhodoferax|Aeromonas|Geothrix|Pseudomonas|^Bacillus|Mucispirillum|Acidiphilium|Anaeromyxobacter|Serratia", Genus) ~ "DIRB",
    grepl("Thiobacillus", Genus) ~ "IOB/DIRB",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  ))


# Environmental vectors
env_df <- as.data.frame(cap_scores$biplot) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

# Explained variance
eig <- eigenvals(cap)
proportion_explained_axis1 <- 
  t(summary(eig)) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "Axis") %>% 
  filter(Axis == "CAP1") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  select(proportion_explained) %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  unique() 
percent_explained_axis1 = 
  round(proportion_explained_axis1 * 100, digits = 1)

proportion_explained_axis2 <-
  t(summary(eig)) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "Axis") %>%

  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  select(cumulative_proportion) %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  unique() 
proportion_explained_axis3 <-
  t(summary(eig)) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "Axis") %>% 
  filter(Axis == "CAP3") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  select(cumulative_proportion) %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  unique() 

percent_explained_axis2 = 
  round(((proportion_explained_axis2 - proportion_explained_axis1) * 100), digits = 1)
percent_explained_axis3 = 
  round(((proportion_explained_axis3-proportion_explained_axis2) * 100 ), digits = 1)
  
axis1_label <- glue("CAP1 ({percent_explained_axis1}%)")
axis2_label <- glue("CAP2 ({percent_explained_axis2}%)")
axis3_label <- glue("CAP3 ({percent_explained_axis3}%)")

# Run anova.cca to determine significantly and strongly correlated species
anova_global <-  anova.cca(cap, parallel = getOption("mc.cores"))

# Run anova.cca to determine significantly and strongly correlated species
anova_result <-  anova.cca(cap, by = "terms", parallel = getOption("mc.cores"))

# save anova
anova_global %>% broom::tidy() %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  write_csv("output_data/capscale_dbRDA_bray_anova_global.csv", col_names = T)

anova_result %>% broom::tidy() %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  write_csv("output_data/capscale_dbRDA_bray_anova_result.csv", col_names = T)

library(tidyverse)

# Extract species and biplot scores
species_scores <- scores(cap, display = "species", scaling = 1)
env_vectors <- scores(cap, display = "bp", scaling = 1)

# significant variables
significant_vars = 
anova_result %>% broom::tidy() %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>% 
  pull(term)

# Initialize an empty list to collect results
results_list <- list()

# Loop through significant environmental variables
for (var in significant_vars) {
  if (var %in% rownames(env_vectors)) {
    var_vector <- env_vectors[var, ]  # Coordinates of the environmental variable
    
    # Compute cosine similarity (correlation in ordination space)
    correlations <- apply(species_scores, 1, function(x) {
      sum(x * var_vector) / (sqrt(sum(x^2)) * sqrt(sum(var_vector^2)))
    })
    
    # Filter strongly positively correlated species (> 0.7)
    strong_positive <- correlations[correlations > 0.7]
    
    if (length(strong_positive) > 0) {
      # Create tibble for this variable
      df <- tibble(
        variable = var,
        ASV = names(strong_positive),
        correlation = as.numeric(strong_positive)
      )
      
      # Store in list
      results_list[[var]] <- df
    }
  }
}

# Combine all into one tibble
strong_positive_species_tibble <- bind_rows(results_list)

# View result
strong_positive_species_tibble

strong_positive_species_tibble %>% 
  group_by(variable) %>% 
  arrange(desc(correlation), .by_group = T) %>% 
  inner_join(.,
             tax_table(physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus) %>% 
               data.frame() %>% as_tibble() %>% 
               mutate(ASV = taxa_names(physeq_core50prev_0.01abund_genus)),
             by = "ASV") %>% 
  inner_join(.,
             psmelt(tax_glom(physeq2_clean, taxrank =  "Genus") %>% transform_sample_counts(., function(x) x/sum(x)*100)) %>% 
               as_tibble() %>% select(ASV = "OTU", Sample, Abundance) %>% 
               group_by(ASV) %>% 
               summarise(max_abund = max(Abundance)),
             by = "ASV") %>% 
  select(-Species) %>% 
  write_csv(glue("output_data/{proj}_Cosine_similarity_correlations_CAP_genus_vs_env_variables.csv"))
```
